title: Five people. Every project.
styleLine: ONE CONSISTENT LINE ACROSS ALL IMAGES (critical). Cinematic editorial photography, shot as if by the SAME photographer on the SAME 35mm lens, same warm natural grade — deep navy shadows (#262B38) + warm cream light (#F7F8EA), rich but natural (NOT a heavy Instagram filter, NOT washed-out, NOT HDR). A modern small software-studio workspace: walnut desks, natural window light, plants, notebooks and coffee cups, closed laptops (lids down, no visible screens). Contemporary and quiet, not corporate — a small serious team, not a coworking-space cliché. NO branded gear, NO visible UI on screens, NO stock 'business meeting' props. 4:5 aspect (1080x1350), designed for Instagram feed carousels (full frame visible) and TikTok photo carousels. SAFE ZONES: (a) Instagram profile grid crops to CENTER 1:1 — the top ~135px and bottom ~135px are cropped in the grid view, so keep the hero subject center-frame. (b) TikTok photo mode overlays a caption/UI region across the bottom ~340px on the visible feed — keep any critical visual detail above that band. (c) The lower ~40% of the frame (roughly y=810 to y=1350 on a 1080x1350 canvas) is reserved for on-slide type — compose the subject in the upper ~55-60% but fill the ENTIRE frame with natural scene content — NO dark band, NO black rectangle, NO artificial dark area. A CSS gradient handles text legibility. No text, no logos, no clearly identifiable faces (backs of heads, hands, over-the-shoulder crops are fine).
note: Path B. All six slides are pure photos. No device composite in this one.

slides.title: ==One person== answers your Monday email
slides.body: Project manager. Scope, timeline, budget, milestones. They never write the code — that's not the job. They make sure the people who do are building the right thing.

slides.title: ==Tech Lead==
slides.body: The one who decides whether your requirement is a template extension or a full custom build. Architecture, code review, integration design.

slides.title: ==Designer==
slides.body: On full-custom builds only. Template projects skip this seat and use a pre-designed theme. If we're quoting you a template, we say so.
